data.asar: South Delhi wali kothi ab sirf sapno me milegi.
data.caption:
South Delhi me ghar lene ka sochna bhi mat! 💸

• South Delhi mein residential floors ke daam achanak badh gaye
• Reports ke mutabik rates mein seedhe 40% tak ka ucchal aaya hai
• Middle class ka posh ilaqe me ghar lene ka sapna fir toot gaya

Yahan toh flat dekhne ke bhi charge lag jayenge lagta hai.

Apne us dost ko tag karo jo hamesha South Delhi ki kothi ke khwab dekhta hai!
